column1: Now there's an unpleasant and unproductive maneuver.

column1: Hey, Bonds! You'd better take some action - SOON!
column2: 嘿，Bonds！你最好快點採取行動──動作快！

column1: 83-32, this is 83-31. I'll cover the passenger side while you make contact with the suspect. Be careful, Sonny. 83-31 out.
column2: 83-32，這裡是 83-31。我掩護乘客那一側，你去跟嫌犯接觸。小心點，Sonny。83-31 通話結束。

column1: Who would have known that he would have the dexterity to pull that Smith and Wesson out of his back pocket and blow you away while handcuffed? Looks like you forgot one teeny bit of police procedure. At least this perp will never bother anyone again...Jack ventilated him. Not that it does you any good.
column2: 誰想得到他手銬都還銬著，居然還有那份靈活從後褲袋掏出那把 Smith and Wesson，一槍把你打倒？看來你漏掉了一丁點警察程序。至少這個嫌犯再也不會騷擾任何人了……Jack 把他打成了篩子。只是這對你已經於事無補。

column1: There's nothing you can do here. If this really was the scene of a crime, Homicide would have taken samples long ago.
column2: 這裡沒有你能做的事了。如果這裡真的是犯罪現場，兇殺組早就採過樣了。

column1: There is a large, ugly stain on the sidewalk. In this area of town, it could be a blood stain as easily as it could be an oil stain.
column2: 人行道上有一大片難看的污漬。在鎮上這一帶，那可能是血漬，也可能只是油漬。

column1: There's no reason to touch the street, Bonds.
column2: Bonds，沒理由去碰這條街道。

column1: Just another Lytton city street. This one seems more badly kept than usual.
column2: 又是一條 Lytton 市區的街道，這條看起來比平常更加乏人維護。

column1: Your partner blows the guy into next week, but too late to save you. You should have followed proper police procedure, Bonds. Better luck in your next life.
column2: 你的搭檔一槍把那傢伙打得魂飛魄散，但已經來不及救你了。Bonds，你早該遵守正確的警察程序。祝你下輩子好運。

column1: And a Smith and Wesson .45 automatic.
column2: 還有一把 Smith and Wesson .45 自動手槍。

column1: You'll need to be standing for that.
column2: 你得先站起來才能這麼做。
